Create a Korean hanok compound of roughly five low timber buildings around small courtyards, with a recessed wooden gate and two or three detached pavilions. Center it on a broad empty checkerboard-tiled platform. Use dark sweeping roofs and white plaster; exclude vegetation, furnishings, people, roads, fences, and surrounding landscape.
